slovenia-2009.notes: Source 1 is a crawl of tekmovanja.acm.si with pages from 2011 onward; nothing in it about the 2009 UPM contest, so verdict wrong-contest (series site of other editions).

sources.evidence: The 149 pages are the ACM Tekmovanja site (Bober, RTK, UPM) with news and event pages from 2011 onward, and nothing in them is about the 2009 UPM contest; the only occurrence of 2009 is a link to an RTK 2009 bulletin.

sources.evidence: The front page announces the 2011 season of the Univerzitetni programerski maraton with first round on 14.4.2011 and second round on 12.5.2011, and the menu pages for presentation, schedule, rules and teams are of 2011.
